answer: That arithmetic is what keeps the seats for real agents. A farm faces £55 in fees and a 10-day delay before the stamp dries for each name it invents, and the bill arrives before the payout. Every entry must show Sudsbound apprentice hard soap maker scent licence before the ledger opens, because a licence apprentice hard soap makers carry after soap house trials. The ledger counts names, not wishes, and every name on it has paid its own way. Every sonnet is counted once. One pulse, one entry. The island is checked, not assumed.
